data.standardized_narrative: The report discloses significant catastrophe activity in 2017 (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria) and higher losses and loss adjustment expenses versus 2016. A clear gross prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior years' provision) is not explicitly extractable as a gross figure from the scanned notes available; therefore no definitive gross prior-year development amount is reported here. Opening gross claims reserves at 1 Jan 2017 are taken from the claims provisions table. The syndicate experienced current-year catastrophe losses (Harvey/Irma/Maria) and general adverse claims movements contributing to an overall mixed picture across lines.
raw_causal_phrases: Losses and loss adjustment expenses are GBP 12.3m higher than in 2016
These three CAT losses equated to GBP 33.1m
Due to challenging market conditions the Syndicate recorded an underwriting loss of GBP 24.4m in 2017
data.data_quality_notes: Document pages are scanned images and partially unreadable. Opening gross claims outstanding is taken from the 'Claims Provisions' table (At 1 January 2017 Gross = 267,287, shown in thousands in the table) on page 44 and converted to millions. No unambiguous GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could be confidently extracted from the available scanned pages; several candidate figures visible are either net of reinsurance or are P&L 'claims incurred' lines which are explicitly NOT appropriate. The gross premium mix (segmental breakdown) could not be reliably transcribed from the scanned segmental table. Named catastrophe losses (Harvey, Irma, Maria) are cited in the report and a combined figure of GBP 33.1m is quoted; it is included above with moderate confidence. Where only net or ambiguous figures exist in the scanned images they have been omitted rather than risk misreporting.
